text_block_list.text:
On our way back from grocery shopping with Biwa Hayahide...
we heard cheerful singing in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looking at the posters on the pillars,
it seems an idol concert is underway, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Yeeeah! Crashing the party☆
Tokai Teio is here~!"

text_block_list.name: Idols
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ Everyone's so hyped up!
We're not gonna lose either~♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
T-Teio-kun!?
Why are you dancing with idols... !?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Still... did you see that? Those moves, that expressiveness.
She wouldn't pale beside professional idols."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Guh... Suddenly, I'm feeling really embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Compared to that, my dancing is as stiff as a board.
Conveying my gratitude to the fans like this is simply out of the question...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Is there some kind of secret to it, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, indeed! I would gladly receive your teachings.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there, Teio.
I just watched your performance.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Man,
watching you dance made me wanna join in too.
choice_data_list: That dance could put the pros to shame!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah! And so, I'd like to ask Teio—
No... out of respect, let me put it this way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Master Teio,
please teach me the secret to your dancing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Teacher", huh... ehehe~
Well, I am pretty good at dancing, after all~

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please, teach me! What kind of dancing
will cure me of standing there like a stiff board...?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: A stiff-as-a-board dance~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but sure!
For now, show me a little dance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait... Right here!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm the teacher here~!
Come on, step in rhythm with me~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: L-Like... this...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at that! You're not stiff as a board at all!
Since you're tall, your movements look super dynamic!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You have plenty of weapons I don't have.
Your teacher says you should just build on those!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you're saying
I have my own way of expressing it!

Thanks to the advice, Biwa Hayahide's
dance was polished to an even greater sheen!

text_block_list.name: Live Audience
text_block_list.text:
You're jumping in too, big sis?
Awesome, awesome! I'll be rooting for ya!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait, no... I didn't say anything like that—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Hayahide!
Did watching the dance make you want to dance too?

text_block_list.name: Idols
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa♪ Show me your dance too, show me, show me~!
Come over here and let's danciiing☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Kh! Why did it turn out like this...!?

text_block_list.name: Idols
text_block_list.text:
Ready, and! A fluttering heart is
LOVE-LOVE... kyun☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Kyu, kyuun...

text_block_list.name: Live Audience
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~, so cute! Next, dance together, everyone!
Encore! Encore!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whew, danced my heart out.
Dancing really is the best way to blow off some steam!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Is that... so...?
To be honest, halfway through... I lost myself in the moment...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It was perfect! The audience had such great smiles, too!
After all, feelings are the most important part of dancing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
See?! Even at the Winning Live,
we dance because we want to make the fans happy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...! I see, of course.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
So the answer was within me all along.

And so, Biwa Hayahide's doubts vanished,
polishing her dance moves to an even higher level.
